metadata.description: A design-direction system for coding agents, built from 57 references reverse-engineered frame by frame

plugins.name: drawn-to
plugins.description: Give your coding agent a trained eye. A measured taste library - 57 references, 12 constants, 8 style families - plus a plain-language interview answered with weights instead of forced picks, and a lock file every visual decision has to serve. Ships its own visual evidence.
